name: Littlestone Dimension of Blockwise-Addressing
proof: Query z at the root. In the 0-subtree, the f_i realize every d-bit pattern on any y-block, and in the 1-subtree the g_i realize every d-bit pattern on the corresponding x-block. Thus both subtrees support depth d and the class shatters a tree of depth d+1. It has exactly $2^{d+1}$ concepts, so a deeper complete tree would require more distinct leaf realizers.
